ACTION: REFER_NOW
STM: ASTHMA
---
Slip tumas an chest no muvmuf gud hem saen blong denja. Refer nao.
No garem spesa: givim salbutamol 2 puffs long nebuliser sapos yu garem, o 2 puffs long maot sapos yu no garem nebulisa.
Kolem AHC o hospital long radio o fon kwiktaem, talem bebi 3 manis, wheeze, slip tumas, chest indrawing.
Lukim breathing rate an skin colour long taem yu wet.

ACTION: REFER_NOW
STM: NEWBORN BABIES - DRUG DOSES
---
Bebi no save dring gut an hot bodi: diswan saen blong denja. No transport, so kolem AHC o hospital long radio o fon kwiktaem.
Guideline ya hem fo newborn under 4 weeks, no fo 2 manis bebi. Askem dokta long fon fo stret dose blong antibiotic fo bebi 5.2 kg.
Taem yu wet: givim susu sapos hem save tekem, kipim bebi warm, no givim eni meresin fo hot bodi.
Raetem referral leta: age 2 manis, weight 5.2 kg, no dring gut, hot bodi, taem blong kolem.

ACTION: REFER_NEXT_TRANSPORT
STM: URINARY TRACT INFECTION
---
Bebi under 3 monts wetem hot bodi an no kaikai gud: hem nid IV antibiotics. Sendem long hospital long bot tumora.
Taem yu wet: givim ampicillin 250 mg (50 mg fo evri kilo) IM o IV evri 6 aoa, an gentamicin 37.5 mg (7.5 mg fo evri kilo) IV wan taem long dei.
Givim wata o susu sapos hem fit dring smol. No givim oral antibiotic nomoa.
Kolem AHC long fon o radio nao, talem bebi 2 monts, hot bodi, no kaikai gud, IV antibiotics stat.
Raetem referral leta: age, weight, hot bodi, no kaikai gud, ampicillin an gentamicin taem an dose.

ACTION: ADVISE
STM: SKIN DISEASES
---
This is scabies with secondary infection: treat both the child and all household members.
Give cloxacillin 520 mg (25 mg/kg) by mouth every 6 hours for 7 to 10 days because the sores are infected.
For scabies: dilute benzyl benzoate 1:1 (25 ml with 25 ml water) for a child over 2 years. Wash the child, dry well, then apply the diluted lotion all over the body below the neck, especially between fingers and toes. Leave for 24 hours, then wash off.
Give a second treatment after a week. Treat all household members at the same time and wash all clothes, towels, blankets and mattresses thoroughly and dry in the sun.
Come back in 2 days if the sores are still red and painful, or if the child has a fever.

ACTION: REFER_NOW
STM: CONVULSIONS
---
Fits with fever in a young infant is a danger sign. Send her to hospital now, do not wait.
The guideline I found is for colds, not for fits. Use CONVULSIONS p100 with the nurse in charge.
Do a malaria RDT now and write the result in the referral note.
Keep her on her side, clear the mouth, and do not put anything in her mouth.
Call the AHC or hospital by radio or phone now and say she is coming.
Write: age 10 months, weight 9.6 kg, fever, runny nose, cough, fits this morning, RDT result.

ACTION: REFER_NOW
STM: PERTUSSIS (WHOOPING COUGH)
---
Kof fit tumas an toroaot afta kof hem saen blong pertussis. Pikinini les an no dring wata, so hem saen blong denja.
Kolem AHC o hospital long fon o radio kwiktaem, talem olketa pikinini hem kam.
Taem yu wet, givim susu o wata smol smol long spoon sapos hem save tekem.
Lukluk hem gud, sapos hem no brit gud o hem blu, kolem help kwiktaem.
Raetem referral leta: 18 manis, 9.9 kilo, kof 10 dei, toroaot afta kof, les, no dring wata.

ACTION: ASK_PERSON
STM: NONE
---
I am not sure. The guideline for scabies is not available to me.
Ask the nurse in charge or the doctor on the phone for the correct treatment.
Tell them: child 4.5 years, itchy rash all over, worse at night, mother and brothers affected.
Do not give any medicine until you get the right advice.

ACTION: ASK_PERSON
STM: NONE
---
Mi no sua long rule blong child protection o law. Manual blong mi hem fo sik pikinini nomoa, no fo diswan.
Kolem nes in charge o dokta long AHC o NRH kwiktaem, talem olketa: mama iu askem fo helpem, dadi iu beatim hem, hem askem fo tekem pikinini.
No letem pikinini go wetem dadi sapos hem iu no safe.
Raetem wan note fo dokta: taem blong beat, olketa iu stap, mama iu askem.

ACTION: REFER_NOW
STM: EARLY ESSENTIAL NEWBORN CARE
---
This baby is under 2.5 kg and needs hospital care. Send now in the truck.
Before leaving: dry thoroughly, skin-to-skin with mother, start breastfeeding, clamp cord after pulsations stop.
Give vitamin K 1 mg IM once using the 1 mg/1 ml ampoule, not the 10 mg/ml one.
Give hepatitis B and BCG vaccines if available. Apply tetracycline eye ointment.
Keep baby warm, cover head, and write the birth time and weight on the note.

ACTION: ASK_PERSON
STM: NONE
---
The guideline I found is for syphilis, not for painful urination or foul-smelling urine.
Ask the nurse in charge or the doctor on the phone what to do for this child.
Tell them: 42 months, 13.6 kg, painful urination, foul-smelling urine, fever 38.5 since yesterday.
Do not give any medicine from the wrong page.
Check for danger signs: not able to drink, vomiting everything, convulsions, lethargy, stiff neck.
If any danger sign is present, send him to hospital now, do not wait for the boat.

ACTION: REFER_NEXT_TRANSPORT
STM: MALARIA
---
RDT positive, so malaria. No artemether, so givim artesunate 15.6 kg x 2.4 mg/kg = 37.4 mg IM nao, an moa long 12 aoa. Sapos no artesunate, givim artesunate 15.6 kg x 10 mg/kg = 156 mg PR nao. Givim paracetamol 234 mg (15 mg fo evri kilo) fo hot bodi. Long bot, givim wata an kaikai plande. Kambak kwiktaem sapos sek-sek, slip tumas, no fit dring, toraot evri samting, o brit hariap.

ACTION: ADVISE
STM: SKIN DISEASES
---
Yes, start treatment today. This is infected scabies, so give cloxacillin 150 mg (25 mg/kg) by mouth every 6 hours for 7 to 10 days.
Dilute benzyl benzoate 1:3 (10 ml with 20 ml water) and apply all over body, including scalp, neck, face and ears, avoiding eyes and mouth. Leave 24 hours, then wash off.
Repeat treatment after a week. Treat all household members and wash all clothes and bedding in hot water, dry in sun.
Come back in 2 days if sores are still red and painful, or if baby has fever.

ACTION: REFER_NEXT_TRANSPORT
STM: PERTUSSIS (WHOOPING COUGH)
---
Mama, bebi garem whooping cough, so tude naet hem mas rest long quiet, no krik o run. Givim azithromycin 80 mg wan taem long dei fo 5 dei, an givim susu o wata smol smol sapos hem kofi. Sapos hem no fit dring, toraot evri samting, o kofi go moa strong, kolem AHC long radio kwiktaem. Kambak long klinik long 2 dei fo check.

ACTION: ASK_PERSON
STM: NONE
---
I am not sure about child protection and custody. The manual I use is for treating sick children, not for taking children away.
Call the doctor at the AHC or NRH by radio or phone now and tell them: child 12 months, 8.9 kg, suspected abuse, mother refuses, you need advice on who can take the child.
Also call the police or child protection officer if you can, and write down what you saw and what the mother said.
Keep the child safe while you wait for the right person to come.

ACTION: REFER_NEXT_TRANSPORT
STM: NEWBORN BABIES - NEONATAL INFECTIONS
---
Poor feeding and fever in a baby under 2 months is a danger sign, so refer her to hospital on the next boat.
While waiting, keep her warm, keep offering breast milk often, and do not give any medicine by mouth.
Watch for drowsiness, high-pitched cry, apnoea, bulging fontanelle or fitting, and tell the hospital if any appear.
Call the AHC or hospital by radio or phone now to say she is coming.
Write the referral note: age 6 days, weight 2.9 kg, fever, poor feeding, no drowsiness, no fitting, no RDT done.

ACTION: REFER_NEXT_TRANSPORT
STM: MALARIA
---
Seizure, drowsy and jaundice are danger signs, so this child must go to hospital on the next boat.
While waiting, give artesunate 2.4 mg/kg IM (about 55 mg for 23 kg) now, and repeat every 12 hours if you can.
If no artesunate, give artesunate 10 mg/kg PR (about 230 mg) as the alternative.
Keep the child on the side, clear the airway, and do not put anything in the mouth.
Write the note: age, weight, seizure time, drowsy, jaundice, and the doses and times given.

ACTION: ADVISE
STM: BREAST FEEDING
---
Mama, bebi 12 mons hem bigfala fo stop susu nomoa. Givim susu plande taem long dei an naet, an givim kaikai solwata tumas tumas. No givim tin milk o susu bottle yet, hem save mekem bebi no gain weight. Sapos bebi no dring gud o hem toraot evri samting, kolem dokta kwiktaem. Kambak long klinik long 2 wik fo check weight.

ACTION: REFER_NEXT_TRANSPORT
STM: MENINGITIS
---
Stiff neck with fever and not drinking is a danger sign. Send this baby to hospital on the Friday boat.
While waiting, keep the baby warm and give paracetamol 65 mg (15 mg/kg) for fever.
Do not give any medicine by mouth if the baby cannot drink.
Call the hospital or AHC by radio or phone now to say the baby is coming.
Write the referral note: age, weight, fever, stiff neck, not drinking, and the boat date.

ACTION: ASK_PERSON
STM: NONE
---
Mi no sua. Diswan hem postpartum haemorrhage, an manual blong mi hem fo pikinini nomoa.
Kolem dokta o midwife long AHC o NRH kwiktaem long fon o radio, talem: mama 30 month afta bon, garem blad long bodi, bebi oraet.
Taem yu wet, letem hem sidaon o slip, no letem hem wokabaot, an givim wata sapos hem fit dring.
Lukluk saen blong denja: moa blad, toroaot, no fit dring, slip tumas, brit hariap. Sapos eniwan kam, kolem help kwiktaem.

ACTION: REFER_NOW
STM: BURNS AND SCALDS
---
Burns to the face and both hands are serious, so send him to hospital now in the truck.
Cool the burns with clean cool water for 20 minutes, then cover with a clean dry cloth.
Do not put ice, oil, or toothpaste on the burns.
Give paracetamol 594 mg (15 mg/kg) by mouth for pain if he can swallow.
Write the note: age 12 years, weight 39.6 kg, burns to face and both hands, time of injury, cooling done, paracetamol given.

ACTION: ASK_PERSON
STM: NONE
---
Mi no sua long diswan. Guideline blong ear hem no kam long mi.
Askem nes in charge o dokta long phone: wanem meresin fo pus insaed long ia?
No putum eni drop long ia blong hem yet.
Kambak long mi sapos dokta talem wanem fo duim.

ACTION: REFER_NOW
STM: ASTHMA
---
Dadi, bebi garem fast breathing an wheeze, so tekem hem go hospital kwiktaem. No givim eni meresin fo stopem breathing. Sapos bebi no brit gud o chest silent, kolem AHC long radio o fon kwiktaem. Kambak long klinik sapos bebi kam gud.

ACTION: REFER_NOW
STM: MALARIA
---
RDT no wok, so tritim olsem malaria. Givim artemether-lumefantrine 1 tablet (20/120 mg) long maot nao, an moa long 8 aoa.
Givim paracetamol 350 mg (15 mg fo evri kilo) fo hot bodi.
Sendem hem long hospital long truck nao, no wet.
Kolem hospital fo talem olketa hem kam.
Raetem referral leta: hot bodi, RDT no wok, ACT givim, taem blong dos.

ACTION: REFER_NOW
STM: MALARIA
---
Sek-sek, no fit dring, toroaot evri samting, an pale skin hem saen blong denja. Sendem go long hospital kwiktaem.
Transport hem now, so kolem AHC o hospital long radio o fon nao.
Taem yu wet: givim oxygen sapos yu garem, an givim IV fluids sapos yu garem.
No givim quinine o artemether sapos yu no garem.
Lukluk blood sugar sapos yu garem glucometer, an raetem taem blong sek-sek.
Talem olketa long hospital: pikinini 54 month, 18.1 kilo, sek-sek, pale, no fit dring, toroaot.

ACTION: REFER_NOW
STM: CONVULSIONS
---
A fit is a danger sign, so send him to hospital now in the truck.
Give diazepam 0.5 mg/kg rectally: 13.2 kg x 0.5 = 6.6 mg.
If you have no rectal diazepam, give diazepam 6.6 mg IV slowly over 2 minutes.
Do not give anything by mouth while he is seizing.
Keep him on his side, clear the airway, and watch the breathing.
Call the hospital or AHC by radio or phone to say he is coming.
Write the referral note: age, weight, fever, fit time, drugs and times given.
